name: clinc150-banking15+oos
instructions: A customer sent this message to a bank's support assistant. Which option best describes what the customer wants? Pick exactly one option. Pick out_of_scope if the message is not about any of the listed banking requests.

label_descriptions.transfer: Move money between accounts or send money to someone
label_descriptions.transactions: See recent transactions or a specific charge on the account
label_descriptions.balance: Ask how much money is in an account
label_descriptions.bill_balance: Ask how much is owed on a bill
label_descriptions.bill_due: Ask when a bill is due
label_descriptions.interest_rate: Ask what interest rate an account earns or charges
label_descriptions.routing: Ask for the bank's routing number
label_descriptions.min_payment: Ask for the minimum payment due
label_descriptions.order_checks: Order new paper checks / a checkbook
label_descriptions.report_fraud: Report fraud or a transaction the customer did not make
label_descriptions.account_blocked: Account is blocked or locked and the customer cannot use it
label_descriptions.spending_history: Ask how much was spent on something over a period
label_descriptions.out_of_scope: None of the listed requests: anything else, including non-banking chit-chat or tasks
